verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS search API, since vendors can offer on-prem or enterprise deployments, but nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable core product. Every integration path, including the client libraries and the open-source MCP server repo, calls SerpApi's hosted endpoint at serpapi.com with an API key, and the plans are cloud subscriptions. Client libraries and an MCP wrapper are adjacent pieces and earn no credit toward self-hosting the core scraping service.
